rachel (Eng Manager): Quick Q — planning a promotion L5 -> L6 for Sam, effective 2026-07-01. This includes manager track change + 15% base bump. Is this considered a mid-cycle comp change that needs comp committee? Also what's the minimum packet to submit?

nina (People Ops): Congrats! Any >10% or move above band midpoint triggers comp committee review. Since this is manager-track and 15%, yes, committee required. Packet: promo note, manager justification, updated scorecard, org chart, and proposed comp + equity ask.

olga (Compensation): Add market data and peer comps. For manager track promotions include team size expectations and direct report examples. If you want accelerated committee review, use "expedite" and provide business reason.

rachel (Eng Manager): Timeline concerns — committee meets Wednesdays. If we submit by 2026-06-23, will approvals make payroll for July 1 effective date?

payroll-bot: Payroll cutoff for July effective dates: 2026-06-20 17:00 PDT. Committee approvals after payroll cutoff will still set effective date as 2026-07-01 but pay will start in the next payroll cycle. See https://intra.redwood/payroll.

ira (People Ops): Note re: manager-track: update job family and leveled expectations in the packet. Also include proposed 90-day check-in plan for leadership transition. We require director sign-off for manager-track promotions.

ben (Finance): From finance: include GL code and projection of incremental run-rate. Also flag headcount change if this promotion creates new hiring needs. Big note: any comp move >$12k annual requires VP finance approval.

sam (IC): As the impacted person: will my vesting or existing refresh be affected by manager switch? Also curious about title change on badge/Slack.

nina (People Ops): Vesting unaffected for existing awards. New manager grant will start on grant date. We'll update title in HRIS and Slack on the effective date. Badge/place listing updates may require facilities notice — if so, include facilities tag.

rachel (Eng Manager): Helpful — any suggested one-paragraph justification template?

olga (Compensation): Try: "Recommendation to promote Sam to L6 (manager track) effective 2026-07-01 based on leadership of Project R (launched 2026-02), direct management of two ICs with measurable growth, owning cross-team roadmap, and performance above peers. Requesting +15% base and one-time equity refresh to align to manager median."

rachel (Eng Manager): Thanks — I'll draft and share the packet here for quick review before submission. Tagging @ira and @olga.

ira (People Ops): Happy to review the draft. If you need sign-off from the director, cc them in the packet. Good luck! :slightly_smiling_face:
